purpose: To provide a consistent, timely, and localized notification system for customers through email, SMS, and push messages.

components.name: domain-events
components.evidence: Domain events arrive on the shared event stream (domain-events, Kafka).

components.name: notifier
components.evidence: The notifier service reads each event, decides which template and channel apply, renders the message and hands it to our email and SMS provider for delivery.

components.name: external provider
components.evidence: The platform is designed for at-least-once delivery, with de-duplication on the notification identifier so customers do not receive the same message twice.

flows.evidence: Domain events arrive on the shared event stream (domain-events, Kafka).
